close_reason: No-action: SHA-256 of ~100 bytes is microseconds; endpoint is called once per day per remote MTA, not a hot path. Precomputing would add blast radius across ~8 AppState construction sites for negligible gain.
description: server.rs mta_sts_handler calls render_mta_sts_policy on every request to /.well-known/mta-sts.txt, recomputing the body string and SHA-256 each time. The config is immutable at runtime, so (body, policy_id) can be precomputed once. Fix: precompute per MtaStsDomainConfig at server startup and cache in AppState.
title: render_mta_sts_policy recomputes SHA-256 on every HTTP request
